As an order picker/warehouse employee, you’ll be responsible for collecting orders using a voice-picking system, which can be set in multiple languages, including Dutch, English, and Polish. Together with your team, you’ll make sure all orders are ready on time for stores in the Netherlands and Belgium.

You’ll use your organizational skills to efficiently load products onto pallets. These pallets can include items like toothpaste, shampoo, cleaning supplies, toys, and clothing. Since no two pallets are the same, every day brings new challenges.

At AS Watson, you’ll work in a two-shift schedule and receive attractive bonuses of up to 150% per hour for late shifts. Plus, you’ll be part of a friendly team where collaboration is key.

- You work accurately and take responsibility
- Willing to work in two shifts (06:00 - 14:00 and 14:00 - 22:00)
- Flexible availability, part-time options possible
- Minimum availability on Mondays and Tuesdays, plus two Saturday mornings per month
- Own transportation required, as the location is not easily accessible by public transport

Are you creative enough to source parts that almost no one else can find?

As a Purchasing Officer, you are responsible for sourcing all required parts for a single aircraft, from A to Z. This is not a role focused on routine purchasing or recurring orders. Your challenge is to track down critical aircraft parts when the source is unknown, supply is limited, or availability is extremely scarce. For you, "impossible" is not an option. If a manufacturer cannot deliver a part for several months, you proactively explore alternative solutions; for example, by creatively reallocating components from other aircraft undergoing maintenance.

You will work closely with a multidisciplinary team of B1 Licensed Aircraft Engineers, B2 Avionics Engineers, and the Planning Department to ensure maintenance projects stay on schedule. In addition, you will meet with clients once or twice a week to provide updates on part availability and sourcing progress. This role requires persistence, creativity, strong communication skills, and the ability to think beyond conventional procurement methods to keep aircraft flying.

We’re looking for motivated full-time logistics professionals to join our dynamic facility in Helmond. If you speak English and have experience with order picking, this is your chance!

What are you going to do?
Join the team and help ensure smooth and accurate order processing!

- Order Picking: Use an Electric Pallet Truck (EPT) and hand scanner to pick orders accurately and report discrepancies.
- Packing: Pack products with care, using the correct boxes and labels to ensure safe and timely delivery.
- Continuous Improvement: Contribute to projects that enhance safety, efficiency, and overall performance.

Your schedule:

Monday to Friday, two shifts:

- Morning: 06:00 – 14:00
- Afternoon: 14:00 – 22:00

Accommodation is not included.

In addition to a gross hourly wage of €16,10 bruto per hour (with 7% shift allowance) that will be paid weekly, we offer:

- 25% overtime allowance and even 50% on Saturdays;
- Travel allowance will be € 0,23 per km (0-35 kilometer single trip);
- Quarterly bonus opportunities;
- 8.33% holiday allowance & 25 days of leave (full-time basis);
- Possibility of a permanent contract and skill development.

﻿You will be working at Valeo, a manufacturer of car parts. Parts such as clutch plates, windshield wipers and ignition locks are transported throughout Europe from the location in Helmond. The company is easy to reach by car and is located in the lively Eindhoven region. Parking is free. There is a good atmosphere within the company and fun activities are often organized, such as an annual family day. During your break you can enjoy free coffee, tea or soup.

- You speak and understand English;
- You have experience as an order picker using a hand scanner and EPT;

Are you interested?
